description: Na₂MgH₄(SO₄)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.52 Å. Mg is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.15 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.00 Å) and one longer (1.76 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.01 Å) and one longer (1.69 Å) H-O bond length. S is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.55-1.57 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Mg, and one S atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂MgS trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two H, and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Mg, and one S atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂MgS trigonal pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na, one Mg, and two H atoms.
